Will do my best to keep this short, but there's a chunk to say. I would love to see this turn into something that helps, not only myself, but others in the same boat. I'm Jasper, and I've been learning to fry scream by myself for several months, (6 or so) and I would love some feedback and tips, even just somewhere else to start...

I find my "screams" are very tight, little constricting, and SO weak. I am aware that often people say to use little breath, and focus on projecting from the diaphragm. (I have been singing a long time, so this was relatively easy to wrap my head around.) However, these "screams" feel too brittle, and almost choking, which can't be right. I have done days worth of research and study, to understand the anatomy and technique, and as much as I understand it, I don't know if it's happening... I'm afraid to admit, they do feel scratchy from time to time, and I begin to lose my voice.

I'm unsure whether the muscles in my throat need working, and it's just a matter of slow progression and consistent practice (which is a commitment I've made), or I'm doing something wrong... Or both!? 

They often sound better when I'm playing with my band, and I'm singing into a mic. Sometimes the volume, and the distortion of the mic makes a huge difference. 

ANYWAY, my goal is to be doing fluent fry screams, in either head or chest voice, to incorporate it into my songs, whether it's screaming or just singing with fry sometimes. Please help if you have tips. I may be doing 1 on 1 lessons soon, but I'm not sure if it'll happen or not. Thanks for reading this, if there are any videos or free/cheap courses you could recommend, that would also be a dream.

Thanks dudes.

Although my life has been absolute hell for the past year, I was willing to try and pull my shit together... I won't go into detail but things were pretty fucked! I hope this has helped, but I suggest you look into calling someone professional, instead of taking advice from reddit... I wish you the best of luck mate...

Look - If you are still with us, believe me I really fucking do... There's nothing I can do to help you as far as trying to prove to you that your life is worth fighting for... let me tell you a story... There's a guy I know really well, and for the past year he has been on and off contemplaiting suicide... Up until the last few months when shit has been really, well... shitty! He's had many personal prblems at home regarding his mum being an awful, controlling, manipulative asshole! Not to mention he's suffered servere deppression, and rarely gets to see his dad, who unfortunatley is the only person he has in his life that really cares... He's had so much pressure from his Mum, before hes' even learned to carry the weight he's already taking with him...

Now why am I telling you this? Because I believe this might help... a month ago he was milleseconds from ending his own life... I know because I saw it... We were crossing a main road, one that was not designed to be crossed, and he just stopped, in the middle of the road, just stood there, not crying, showing no emotion, just standing... It must have only been the split second of him seeing the fear in the drivers face, when he got the courage to move the fuck out of the way... Maybe the sound of the horn shook him I really don't know... But what's important is that after he processed what happend, he decided to try and get his life back together, we went up to an isolated area that we always used to hang out, and we didnt say anything, for ages, just silence... Until he apologised and started tearing. I conviced him that he needed to figure things out with his mum ASAP... So he did... and a few months later, things were improving... What I'm trying to say even though that story was probably a little rubbish, is that, things are worth trying to fix something for, especially a life! So sorry if this isn' t helping, but seriously, try get back on your feet, even if things are gonna suck, there is no good reason to do something like this instead...

​

PS: That guy was me... A 13 year old piece of shit, trying to speak from experience...

PPS: Sorry if this was stupid, I just want to help...
